meta.title: pc to AU Converter — Parsec to Astronomical Unit
meta.description: Convert Parsec (pc) to Astronomical Unit (AU) instantly. 1 pc = 206270 AU. Free, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: Convert parsecs (pc) to astronomical units (AU) instantly. Both measure length, so the relationship is strictly linear: each parsec equals 206270 astronomical units. Use the converter above for any value, or read on for the formula, a quick lookup table, and practical tips.
content.result_section: One parsec is equal to **206270 astronomical units**. To go the other way, one astronomical unit equals **4.848102e-6 parsecs**. For everyday use, rounding to 2–4 decimal places is usually enough; for engineering or scientific work, keep the full precision shown by the converter.
content.formula_section:
The conversion is a single multiplication:

> astronomical units = parsecs × 206270

Worked example — converting 10 parsecs:

10 × 206270 = **2063000 AU**.

To invert, divide by 206270 (or multiply by 4.848102e-6).
content.use_cases:
- Cooking and recipe conversions when switching between metric and imperial measurements.
- Travel planning where signage and maps use different unit systems.
- DIY and home-improvement projects that mix metric materials with imperial tools.
- Fitness tracking when devices report in one system and goals are set in another.
- Shipping and logistics where weight and dimensions drive cost.
content.tips:
Keep the factor handy: 1 pc ≈ 206270 AU. For rough mental math, round to the nearest sensible digit.

Mind the units. Parsec and Astronomical Unit both measure length; squared or cubic variants need a different factor (factor², factor³).

When precision matters (engineering, lab work, dosing), avoid rounding mid-calculation — convert once at the final step using the full factor.
content.faq:
**Q:** How many astronomical units are in 1 parsec?
**A:** 206270 astronomical units.

**Q:** What's the formula to convert pc to AU?
**A:** astronomical units = parsecs × 206270.

**Q:** How do I convert AU back to pc?
**A:** Multiply by 4.848102e-6 (or divide by 206270).

**Q:** Is rounding to 2 decimal places accurate enough?
**A:** For most everyday uses, yes. For scientific or engineering work, use the full precision from the converter.

**Q:** Does this pc to AU converter work offline?
**A:** Yes — all math runs in your browser, no network required after the page loads.
